items.content: Remind me that the 600mm I rented from Kestrelworks has to go back by 4 March 2026, or they charge me for a full extra week.
items.query: When is the Kestrelworks return deadline?

items.content: The Sony A1 body has a hairline crack near the battery door, so I tape it before any rain outing.
items.query: Which camera is damaged and needs covering in wet weather?

items.content: Odalys Brenner at Fernline Press only wants RAW files delivered through a shared drive folder, never as email attachments.
items.query: How does Fernline like to receive images?

items.content: Recap of the Svalbard trip planning: flights booked via Oslo, polar bear guard hired for six days, cold-weather batteries ordered, and the insurance rider still pending.
items.query: What's the status of arrangements for the Arctic archipelago expedition?

items.content: On 12 May 2026 the drone went down in Loch Varrin during the otter shoot; the SD card was recovered but the gimbal is dead.
items.query: What gear was wrecked at Varrin?

items.content: I've drafted the licensing quote for the heron series at 1,800 euros for two years of web use, matching your rate from the museum deal.
items.query: How much did we propose for the wading bird pictures' online rights?

items.content: Invoice TQ-4471 to the Halden Wetlands Trust covers the March bittern survey images and is due net-30.
items.query: What does TQ-4471 bill for?

items.content: My agent Tobias would rather get a phone call before 9am than a text whenever a shoot date moves.
items.query: How does my representative like to be told about schedule changes?

items.content: Wrap-up of the Marrowind Estate commission: 42 selects delivered, two reshoots of the red deer rut scheduled, and the second payment received in full.
items.query: Where do things stand with the Marrowind job?

items.content: On 3 August 2026 my 100-400 lens was stolen from the car at a trailhead parking lot outside Brecca.
items.query: When did someone take my zoom from the vehicle?

items.content: Can you add the Gitzo GT3543 tripod to the insurance schedule? It's worth about 1,100 dollars.
items.query: What did I want done with the GT3543?

items.content: The studio's backup NAS sits in the hallway closet and mirrors to the cloud every night at 2am.
items.query: Where is the storage box for redundant copies of my archive kept?

items.content: For the Quillon Safaris catalogue I like to shoot at f/8 and keep ISO under 3200 so the printer gets clean files.
items.query: What exposure settings do I favor for the Quillon work?

items.content: Year-end tally for 2025: 61 paid assignments, three new editorial clients, gross income roughly 74,000 euros, and gear spending down by a fifth.
items.query: What did my annual business scorecard show?

items.content: The Thornequay harbour seal shoot on 21 September 2026 was cut short when the coast guard closed the jetty for a storm warning.
items.query: Why did the Thornequay session end early?

items.content: Your Kenya visa is approved; the e-visa PDF is saved in the Travel folder and expires on 30 January 2027.
items.query: Has my entry permit for the East African country come through?

items.content: Pinebrook Gazette's photo desk pays a flat 275 dollars per published image, plus 40 for each online reuse.
items.query: What is the rate at Pinebrook for pictures?

items.content: I'd rather sleep in a cheap guesthouse close to the hide than a nice hotel an hour's drive away.
items.query: Do I value proximity to the blind over comfort when booking lodging?

items.content: Notes from the call with Arnault Okonkwo-Reyes: he wants 12 puffin prints for the Nordvik exhibition at 60x90 cm, shipping by sea freight, deadline 15 November 2026.
items.query: What did we agree for the Nordvik show?

items.content: Picked up the repaired Nikon Z9 from Halvard Camera Service on 2 October 2026; the shutter was replaced under warranty.
items.query: When did I retrieve my fixed mirrorless body, and did that cost anything?

items.content: Wren here: I've got the spare key to the Gorsemead tool shed now, so text me if you need the wheelbarrow.
items.query: Who can let people into the Gorsemead storage hut?

items.content: Plot 6 has the waist-high beds built for wheelchair access, next to the north gate.
items.query: Which allotment is set up for members with disabilities?

items.content: Marisol in bed 9 asks that nobody scatter Sproutwell slug pellets near her lettuces, even though they're labelled organic; she sticks to beer traps.
items.query: Who objects to Sproutwell being used around her greens?

items.content: April work-day recap: compost bins turned, the rain barrel overflow pipe fixed, 30 strawberry crowns planted, and two new members signed up.
items.query: At which gathering did a pair of recruits enroll and the water butt's spillover outlet get repaired?

items.content: On 14 June 2026 the Larkhollow beehive swarmed and settled in the plum tree; Dev from the beekeeping club collected it that evening.
items.query: What did the Larkhollow colony do?

items.content: The water bill for the quarter came to 187 dollars, so each of the 22 plots owes 8.50.
items.query: How much is every gardener chipping in for the irrigation charges?

items.content: The Brambleton soil test came back at pH 6.2 with low potassium, so we're adding wood ash to the east beds.
items.query: What did the Brambleton analysis show?

items.content: Most members voted to keep the gate unlocked during daylight hours instead of using a combination padlock.
items.query: Do people want the entrance left open while the sun is up?

items.content: Treasurer's update from Ilse Vandermolen: seed order 140 dollars, new hose 55, compost delivery 210, leaving 615 in the kitty.
items.query: What did Vandermolen report about our finances?

items.content: A hard frost on 9 May 2026 killed most of the tomato seedlings that had been set out too early.
items.query: When did a cold snap destroy the young vegetable starts?
